name: Pakistan Stock Exchange
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars 4.13.2 (backfill; not independently verified): 197 closures (57 named; the 140 unnamed are exchange_calendars' Islamic holidays, which it lists ad hoc by year: Eid-ul-Fitr, Eid-ul-Azha, Ashura, Eid Milad-un-Nabi, plus 2010-01-01) and no early closes. None is moved to ad_hoc_closures: they are scheduled moon-dated holidays, not unscheduled closures. No 2010-2024 corrections. Iqbal Day: exchange_calendars closes 9 November 2010-2012 and from 2022, matching its removal from the federal list in 2015 and restoration in 2022 (lead; the notifications were not read); 9 November 2013 and 2014 were weekends. Checked 2026-11-20 (4c13). Last published year: PSX Public Notice PSX/N-89 of 20 January 2026 (https://dps.psx.com.pk/download/attachment/268947-1.pdf), 'Holiday Calendar - 2026', 17 days, the Islamic ones subject to the moon. Corrections (3; both libraries and the pre-4c13 file trade on them): Ashura 2026 is Thursday 25 and Friday 26 June per PSX/N-732 of 16 June 2026 (https://dps.psx.com.pk/download/attachment/278691-1.pdf: 'Ashura holidays on June 25 and June 26, 2026', non-trading days; N-89 had listed 24 and 25 June); Eid Milad-un-Nabi 2026 (12th Rabi-ul-Awwal, a PSX holiday in N-89, listed for 25 August subject to the moon) fell on Wednesday 26 August per the State Bank of Pakistan's circular of 24 August 2026 (https://www.sbp.org.pk/circulars/bprd-circular-letter-no-18-of-2026: 26 August 2026 'i.e. 12th Rabi-ul-Awwal, 1448 A.H.'). Eid-ul-Azha 2026 is 26-28 May per PSX/N-628 of 20 May 2026 (https://dps.psx.com.pk/download/attachment/277567-1.pdf), as the file already had. No 2027 calendar is published; 2027-2029 is the standing pattern with predicted Islamic dates. Hours (ADR 0013): PSX's trading-hours page (https://psx.com.pk/psx/exchange/general/trading-hours; no effective date) gives Monday to Thursday pre-open 09:15-09:30, order matching and confirmation 09:30-09:32, open 09:32-15:30, close 15:30, post-close session 15:35-15:50; it describes no closing auction, so the close is the end of continuous trading, 15:30, as in the file. The registry keeps open 09:30 (the end of the pre-open; continuous trading starts 09:32). Friday runs two sessions (09:17-12:00 and 14:32-16:30, post-close 16:35-16:50) and Ramadan has its own schedule each year (PSX notices); the schema has no weekday-specific or seasonal sessions, so neither is modelled (Phase 4d). The single regular_hours entry from 2010-01-01 is unconfirmed: PSX's schedule changed with the new trading system on 25 October 2021 and at other dates (leads, not read; PSX/N-413 of 2020 and its successor for the 2020 COVID hours).
